newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MIXED TO SLIGHTLY SOFTER.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MIXED TO SLIGHTLY SOFTER.

text.p: NWE oil products prices were mixed to slightly softer as benchmark crude and gas oil futures showed small losses in thin early trade on Wednesday, traders said.
Eurograde gasoline were traded around $2 firmer between two refiners at $219 a tonne, but later best bids were pegged back to around $217.
Prompt lifting gas oil barges were on offer at September IPE flat with bids notionally 50 cents lower. Storage and refinery material was on offer at around Sep IPE +$1 in Antwerp.
Refinery and storage diesel in Antwerp was on offer at Sep IPE $3.50 with Rotterdam sellers asking around $4.50.
High sulphur fuel oil barge prices were steady with offers at $196. Early business was thin but good bunker demand was expected to boost prices later.
